name: Travis Moeller
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Currently serving as managing partner at Blair | Kim | Moeller in Seattle, Washington, Travis Moeller works in the firm’s family law department. With his practice primarily focusing on family law matters, he provides comprehensive legal services to clients across Washington. His litigation experience includes protection orders, domestic violence and anti-harassment cases, along with divorce, child support, alimony and custody. With nearly a decade of experience, he has litigated various complex financial matters, high-conflict parenting cases and blended family cases.

With a high priority on tailoring his approach to his legal services, Mr. Moeller ensures that each client's unique circumstances are considered. He believes in fostering open communication and building trust, which allows him to effectively advocate for his clients' best interests. His dedication to achieving favorable outcomes is evident in his meticulous preparation and strategic approach to each case. He is committed to providing compassionate support during challenging times, making him a trusted ally for families navigating complex legal issues.

A skilled trial attorney with a strong record of litigation success in high-stakes cases, Mr. Moeller provides steady, empathetic guidance, helping clients understand their options to make informed, long-term decisions. While fully prepared to advocate in court, he prioritizes efficient, low-stress resolutions through strategic pre-trial negotiations. His pragmatic, hands-on approach combines meticulous preparation with clear communication, balancing legal complexities with his clients' desired outcomes.

Bringing in deep legal insight through his law degree at Seattle University School of Law, Mr. Moeller efficiently balances procedural complexities with a deeply client-centered focus, remaining fiercely attentive to both the unique legal challenges and the heavy emotional nuances of every dispute. He earned his Juris Doctor in 2016 and was admitted to practice in Washington in the same year.
